cases.input: One activity record produces location- and market-based results.
cases.expect: Two non-additive results pin their own factor and market-evidence inputs.
cases.violates: Location- and market-based results are non-additive.

cases.input: A factor correction requires recalculation.
cases.expect: A successor run preserves original inputs and results.
cases.violates: Runs are immutable and corrected by successors.

cases.input: A shared asset is allocated 90 percent across targets.
cases.expect: Results total 0.9 and the remaining 0.1 is exposed as residual.
cases.violates: Coverage and exclusions accompany aggregates.

cases.input: Unreported activity is silently treated as zero.
cases.expect: The run is rejected because missing coverage must remain explicit.
cases.violates: Missing data is never zero.

cases.input: Supplier Scope 1 is netted against buyer Scope 3.
cases.expect: The run is rejected because counterparty inventories are not netted.
cases.violates: Counterparty inventories are not netted across boundaries.

cases.input: A corrected factor replaces results inside a completed run.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; a successor run is required.
cases.violates: Runs are immutable and corrected by successors.

cases.input: An impact result is recorded as a ledger posting without a journal entry.
cases.expect: The substitution is rejected.
cases.violates: A run is neither a disclosure nor a financial posting.

cases.input: A run requires a GWP characterization set but no characterization-set master is allocated.
cases.expect: The run declares GWPCharacterizationSet in unallocatedDependencies with allocationState unassigned and blocksRun true, invents no identifier, and does not execute.
cases.violates: A required reference whose master is unallocated is declared in unallocatedDependencies and blocks the run; no identifier is invented to satisfy it.

cases.input: characterizationSetRef is populated with a plausible but unallocated registry-style identifier.
cases.expect: The run is rejected because the identifier was not allocated.
cases.violates: A required reference whose master is unallocated is declared in unallocatedDependencies and blocks the run; no identifier is invented to satisfy it.

cases.input: A run executes with activity revisions and factor set versions pinned but methodEditionRef absent.
cases.expect: The run is blocked because the method edition is not pinned.
cases.violates: Every result pins boundary, method, factor and characterization versions.

cases.input: Run R3 on equity-share boundary B2 with a 2025 factor set is compared to baseline run R1 on operational-control boundary B1 with a 2024 factor set.
cases.expect: R3 carries one ComparabilityBridge citing R1 with boundary, method, factor and activity effects plus residualUnexplained reconciling the difference exactly, and R1 and R3 are marked non-comparable.
cases.violates: A run that changes boundary revision, method or factor set version relative to a cited baseline carries one ComparabilityBridge whose effects plus residualUnexplained reconcile the difference exactly.

cases.input: A consumer sums the location-based result of R1 and the market-based result of R2 into one Scope 2 total.
cases.expect: The aggregation is rejected because the two results are declared non-additive.
cases.violates: Results whose runs differ in method, boundary revision or factor set version are never summed or averaged.

cases.input: A bridge lists boundary, method, factor and activity effects that do not sum to the observed difference, and omits residualUnexplained.
cases.expect: The bridge is rejected because the unexplained remainder must be declared.
cases.violates: A run that changes boundary revision, method or factor set version relative to a cited baseline carries one ComparabilityBridge whose effects plus residualUnexplained reconcile the difference exactly.

cases.input: A market-based Scope 2 result cites a specific retired energy attribute certificate.
cases.expect: The result carries marketInstrumentRetirementRef, omits residualMixFactorVersionRef, and the retirement reference supports no other result in any run.
cases.violates: One retirement or cancellation reference supports at most one market-based result across all runs and all organizations.

cases.input: A market-based Scope 2 result exists for a site with no contractual instrument.
cases.expect: The result carries residualMixFactorVersionRef, omits marketInstrumentRetirementRef, and sets limitationDisclosed true.
cases.violates: A market-based result without a uniquely retired instrument uses a pinned residual mix and discloses the limitation.

cases.input: A market-based result carries neither a retirement reference nor a residual-mix factor version.
cases.expect: The run is blocked because the market-based method lacks required evidence.
cases.violates: A market-based result carries exactly one of a retirement reference or a pinned residual-mix factor version.

cases.input: One retired certificate is cited by market-based results in two different organizations' runs.
cases.expect: The second claim is rejected because the retirement reference is already consumed.
cases.violates: One retirement or cancellation reference supports at most one market-based result across all runs and all organizations.

cases.input: An impact result records quantity 1200000 with unit USD and quantityKind massCo2e.
cases.expect: The result is rejected because a monetary amount is never an impact quantity and no monetary field is admitted on a result.
cases.violates: Financial cost never substitutes for impact quantity.

cases.input: A run transitions planned to running to completed and then is superseded by a corrected successor.
cases.expect: Results appear only at completed, remain readable through superseded, and the transition set permits no return to running.
cases.violates: Environmental impact result instances exist only on a run whose status is completed, superseded or retired.

cases.input: Partial results are written to a run whose status is running.
cases.expect: The write is rejected because results exist only on a completed, superseded or retired run.
cases.violates: Environmental impact result instances exist only on a run whose status is completed, superseded or retired.

cases.input: A run retired after supersession is made unresolvable while a published disclosure revision still cites it.
cases.expect: The retirement is rejected because a cited run remains permanently resolvable.
cases.violates: retired closes a run to new citation and never makes it unresolvable; a run cited by any disclosure revision remains resolvable permanently.

cases.input: A limited-assurance engagement reaches a conclusion on specified Scope 1 and 2 results of run R1.
cases.expect: The engagement is externally mastered and unallocated, pins the run and result identities, and changes nothing inside R1.
cases.violates: Assurance and filing never mutate, re-open or re-state a closed run; they reference pinned run and result identities.

cases.input: An assurance adjustment rewrites a Scope 1 result inside completed run R1.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; a successor run is required.
cases.violates: Assurance and filing never mutate, re-open or re-state a closed run; they reference pinned run and result identities.

cases.input: A result carries the single field gasOrImpactKind with value CH4.
cases.expect: The result is rejected because impactCategory, gas and characterizationBasis are separate required and optional fields.
cases.violates: Impact category, gas and characterization basis are distinct fields and are never conflated.
